external_inputs.meaning: Original unshipped input files. Their hashes and byte counts are preserved; labels are anonymized and are not packaged paths.
external_inputs.raw_replay: NOT EXECUTED by this compact package; requires retained original raw trajectories and their recorded runtime.

followup_original_to_packaged.generated_artifact_provenance: Generated table and chart headers retain original evidence digests. A generator may recover those digests only after the complete packaged contract and this declaration validate; original and packaged scientific JSON values are identical. Separately pinned analytical schematics are not measured evidence.

original_provenance.aggregate_hashes: run_manifest.aggregate_sha256 and export_manifest.source.aggregate_sha256 describe the original unshipped full aggregate.
original_provenance.original_file_hashes: Each original_sha256 binds the pre-transformation evidence; each packaged_sha256 binds the supplied copy.
original_provenance.run_signatures: Historical hashes of original run identity, retained unchanged; not signatures of an anonymous raw archive.
original_provenance.source_inventories: Recorded original source file hashes and source inventory digests are retained, not assertions about altered packaged tools.
original_provenance.timestamps_and_runtime: Original timestamps, Python build, dependency versions and measured runtimes are preserved as execution metadata.

followup_original_to_packaged.rebound_metadata: Packaged selection hashes, anonymized input-set digests, analysis inventory digest, export manifest and relative output checksums are updated deterministically.
followup_original_to_packaged.scientific_values: All scientific JSON fields, observations, settings and numeric types are unchanged.
followup_original_to_packaged.scope: anonymous compact follow-up and exploratory fixed-history evidence
